mapper.select: SELECT support_requests.thread_id, support_requests.title, support_requests.description, users.username, support_requests.create_time, support_requests.last_update_time, support_requests.last_update_by, support_requests.status FROM support_requests JOIN users ON support_requests.user_id = users.user_id WHERE username = #{username} ORDER BY create_time DESC;

SELECT support_requests.thread_id, support_requests.title, support_requests.description, users.username, support_requests.create_time, support_requests.last_update_time, support_requests.last_update_by, support_requests.status, support_request_comments_table.* FROM support_requests LEFT JOIN ( SELECT support_request_comments.comment_id, support_request_comments.thread_id as comment_thread_id, support_request_comments.comment, users.username as comment_author, support_request_comments.create_time as comment_create_time FROM support_request_comments JOIN users ON support_request_comments.user_id = users.user_id ) support_request_comments_table ON support_requests.thread_id = support_request_comments_table.comment_thread_id JOIN users ON support_requests.user_id = users.user_id WHERE support_requests.thread_id = #{threadId};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO support_requests(title, description, user_id) SELECT #{thread.title}, #{thread.description}, user_id FROM users WHERE username = #{thread.author};
INSERT INTO support_request_comments(thread_id, comment, user_id) SELECT #{comment.threadId}, #{comment.description}, user_id FROM users WHERE username = #{comment.author};
mapper.update: UPDATE support_requests SET last_update_time = CURRENT_TIME(), last_update_by = (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE username = #{input.author}), status = "CLOSE" WHERE thread_id = #{input.threadId};
UPDATE support_requests SET last_update_time = CURRENT_TIME(), last_update_by = (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE username = #{input.author}), status = "OPEN" WHERE thread_id = #{input.threadId};
